screen.home: PDF Kozou home screen. Press Ctrl+O to open files. Alt+T to toggle text to speech. Press F1 for keyboard shortcuts.
screen.trim: Trim page. Enter margin values and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.split: Split page. Select split method and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.merge: Merge page. Add files and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.compress: Compress page. Select a preset and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.rotate: Rotate page. Select rotation angle and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.image: Image export page. Select output format and press Ctrl+Enter to execute.
screen.viewer: Viewer page. Use arrow keys to navigate pages.

shortcut.home: Keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+O to open files. Alt+T to toggle text to speech. Alt+L to switch language. F1 to repeat this list.
shortcut.tool: Keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+Enter to execute. Alt+H to go home. Escape to cancel or go home. Alt+T to toggle text to speech. F1 to repeat this list.
shortcut.viewer: Keyboard shortcuts. Left and right arrow keys to navigate pages. Ctrl+F to search. Alt+H to go home. Alt+T to toggle text to speech. F1 to repeat this list.

file.drop_hint: Drop PDF files here or press Ctrl+O to add files.
